ITEM.Name: ACPI CST C2 Latency
ITEM.Help_text: Enter in microseconds (decimal value). Larger C2 latency values will reduce the number of C2 transitions and reduce C2 residency. Fewer transitions can help when performance is sensitive to the latency of C2 entry and exit. Higher residency can improve performance by allowing higher frequency boost and reduce idle core power. With Linux kernel 6.0 or later, the C2 transition cost is significantly reduced. The best value will be dependent on kernel version, use case, and workload.

ITEM.Help_text: Effective error threshold count (Hex Value) for PCIe AER error. Range : 0x1-0x4E20 (Hex Value)

ITEM.Help_text: When this option is enabled, uncorrected errors detected by the PSP FW or SMU FW that should cause a cold reset, will hang and not reset the system

ITEM.Help_text: Turn on PPIN feature

ITEM.Name: SEV Control
ITEM.Help_text: Can be used to disable SEV. To re-enable SEV, a POWER CYCLE is needed after selecting the "Enable" option.

ITEM.Name: SEV-ES ASID Space Limit
ITEM.Help_text: SEV-ES and SNP guests must use ASIDs in the range 1 through (this value -1). SEV guests must use ASIDs in the range of this value through 1007. To have all ASIDs support SEV-ES or SNP guests, set this value to 1007. The default is 1: all SEV guests and no SEV-ES or SNP guests.

ITEM.Name: SNP Memory (RMP Table) Coverage
ITEM.Help_text: Enabled = ENTIRE system memory is covered.

ITEM.Name: Amount of Memory to Cover
ITEM.Help_text: Specify MB of System Memory to be covered in Hex.

ITEM.Name: RMP Coverage for 64Bit MMIO Ranges
ITEM.Help_text: Control RMP Coverage for 64Bit MMIO above 4GB. Enable = 64Bit MMIO Above 4GB is covered by RMP. Disable = 64Bit MMIO Above 4GB is not covered by RMP.

ITEM.Name: Socket0 RootBridge Mask for 64Bit MMIO RMP Coverage
ITEM.Help_text: Mask for S0 RootBridges covering 64Bit MMIO Ranges. Bit0=RB0,Bit1=RB1,Bit2=RB2...Bit7=RB7

ITEM.Name: Socket1 RootBridge Mask for 64Bit MMIO RMP Coverage
ITEM.Help_text: Mask for S1 RootBridges covering 64Bit MMIO Ranges. Bit0=RB0,Bit1=RB1,Bit2=RB2...Bit7=RB7

ITEM.Name: Split RMP Table
ITEM.Help_text: Control RMP Table Allocation. Enabled=Split RMP Table across sockets. Disabled=Allocate RMP Table at the end of memory.

ITEM.Name: Segmented RMP Table
ITEM.Help_text: Control RMP_CFG[0] "Segmented RMP" feature. Enable = segmented RMP table. Disable = legacy/old single non-segmented RMP table.

ITEM.Name: RMP Segment Size
ITEM.Help_text: Define RMP_CFG[13:8] RmpSegSize (as power of 2) used to split memory ranges into segments, when Segmented RMP is enabled.

ITEM.Name: Action on BIST Failure
ITEM.Help_text: Action to take when a CCD BIST failure is detected.

ITEM.Help_text: Default is 1, can be set to zero for analysis purposes as long as OS supports it.

ITEM.Name: Log Transparent Errors
ITEM.Help_text: Log transparent errors in MCA in addition to debug registers.

MCA_CONFIG[TransparentErrorLoggingEnable] = 1 for each thread and MCA bank.

ITEM.Name: AVX512

ITEM.Help_text: Enable: Optimized caching for REPs. Disable: Legacy caching behavior for REPs.

ITEM.Name: MONITOR and MWAIT disable
ITEM.Help_text: The MONITOR, MWAIT, MONITORX, and MWAITX opcodes become invalid, when Enabled.\nNote: The Global C-state Control must disabled when Enabled.

ITEM.Name: CPU Speculative Store Modes
ITEM.Help_text:
[Warning] If CPU Debug Options/CPU Aggressive Store Speculation is set to "Yes", it'll override the setting of this option and enforce the CPU Speculative Store Mode to be Aggressive.
Balanced: Store instructions may delay sending out their invalidations to remote cacheline copies when the cacheline is present but not in a writable state in the local cache.
More Speculative: Store instructions will send out invalidations to remote cacheline copies as soon as possible.
Less Speculative: Store instructions may delay sending out their invalidations to remote cacheline copies when the cacheline is not present in the local cache or not in a writable state in the local cache.

ITEM.Name: Fast Short REP MOVSB (FSRM)
ITEM.Help_text: Default is 1, can be set to zero for analysis purposes as long as OS supports it.

ITEM.Name: PauseCntSel_1_0
ITEM.Help_text: Number of cycles dispatch is stalled for a thread after dispatching PAUSE instruction. POR is 64 cycles.

ITEM.Name: Prefetch/Request Throttle
ITEM.Help_text: Enables XI logic which calculates average latency, updates throttle level, and sends throttle level messages to L2

ITEM.Name: Scan Dump Debug Enable
ITEM.Help_text:
This option operates like below settings (when enabled) to avoid the reset caused by Syncflood, etc
APCB_TOKEN_UID_PSP_ENABLE_DEBUG_MODE = 1 (Enabled)
APCB_TOKEN_UID_DF_EXT_IP_SYNC_FLOOD_PROP = 1 (Sync flood disabled)
PcdResetCpuOnSyncFlood = 0 (Disable)

ITEM.Help_text: Disable to use fixed L2 replacement/allocation policy

ITEM.Name: Latency Under Load (LUL)
ITEM.Help_text: Enabling may improve latency in heavy BW scenarios. May slightly reduce peak CCD BW.

ITEM.Name: Core Trace Dump Enable
ITEM.Help_text: Enable/Disable Core Trace Dump Feature.

ITEM.Name: FP512
ITEM.Help_text: Indicates support for downgrading FP512 datapath to FP256. Enable = 512bit datapath, Disable=256bit datapath.

ITEM.Name: AMD_ERMSB Reporting
ITEM.Help_text: Report presence of AMD_ERMSB via CPUID. By default, this is reported as true (Enable), the field can be set to false for analysis purposes as long as OS supports it.

ITEM.Name: NUMA nodes per socket
ITEM.Help_text: Specifies the number of desired NUMA nodes per socket. Zero will attempt to interleave the two sockets together.

ITEM.Name: Memory interleaving
ITEM.Help_text: Allows for disabling memory interleaving. Note that NUMA nodes per socket will be honored regardless of this setting.

ITEM.Name: Mixed interleaved mode
ITEM.Help_text: Allows for interleaving UMC and CXL together.

ITEM.Name: CXL Memory interleaving
ITEM.Help_text: Allows for enabling/disabling CXL memory devices interleaving. Option inactive when 'CXL Memory Online/Offline' is enabled.

ITEM.Name: CXL Sublink interleaving
ITEM.Help_text: Enable or disable CXL sublink interleaving. Option inactive when 'CXL Memory Online/Offline' is enabled.

ITEM.Name: DRAM map inversion
ITEM.Help_text: Inverting the map will cause the highest memory channels to get assigned the lowest addresses in the system.

ITEM.Name: Location of private memory regions
ITEM.Help_text: Controls whether or not the private memory regions (PSP, SMU and CC6) are at the top of DRAM, at the top of 1st DRAM pair or distributed. Note that distributed requires memory on all dies. Note that it will always be at the top of DRAM if some dies do not have memory regardless of this option's setting. Also, Consolidation to 1st DRAM pair is only valid in the non-interleaved case.

ITEM.Name: ACPI SRAT L3 Cache As NUMA Domain
ITEM.Help_text: Enabled: Each CCX in the system will be declared as a separate NUMA domain. Disabled: Memory Addressing \ NUMA nodes per socket will be declared.

ITEM.Name: ACPI SLIT Distance Control

ITEM.Name: ACPI SLIT remote relative distance

ITEM.Name: ACPI SLIT virtual distance

ITEM.Name: ACPI SLIT remote socket distance

ITEM.Name: ACPI SLIT local CXL distance

ITEM.Name: ACPI SLIT remote CXL distance
ITEM.Help_text: Specify the distance to a CXL domain on the other socket.

If the DIMMs present in the system are not conducive to bank interleaving operation, then MCT code will not use interleave settings. ITEM.Name: DDR Healing BIST
ITEM.Help_text: This item enables a full memory test. Please note that this is a memory content test and is separate and distinct from the MBIST test of Interface and Data Eye. PMU Mem BIST: this uses PMU firmware to test memory on all channels simultaneously. Failing memory will be repaired using soft or hard PPR depending on the PPR configuration. Self-Healing Mem BIST: this runs the JEDEC DRAM self healing, if the device and DIMM support the feature. The DRAM will do a hard repair for failing memory. PMU and Self-Healing Mem BIST: this option runs the PMU Mem BIST then the Self-Healing Mem BIST tests sequentially.
